item.title: Catchphrase 'Goyim Are People Too' Has The Devout Jews At The Drunken Clam Laughing Out Loud
item.description: "Goyim Are People Too" is a catchphrase in a series of image macros and GIF captions said by an imagined other who is then laughed at by the devout Jewish subjects represented in the chosen image.

item.title: The 'Baki Walk' Is Going Viral On TikTok As One Of The Creepier Ways To Follow Someone Around
item.description: Baki Walk or the Baki Shadow Clone Walk is a trend where two or more people walk very close together in single file, matching each other's arm and leg movements exactly, referencing a scene from Baki Hanma season two, episode two where Retsu sneakily follows a soldier by walking extremely close behind him. The trend was first popularized on TikTok by @almightydut in September 2023. It experienced a revival in November 2025, set to the song "Habits" by OsamaSon.

item.title: Joel Moran's 'That's What Legends Do' Rants Inspires A Trend About Hyping Up The Biggest Legends On TikTok
item.description: That's What Legendary Players Do refers to a rant by Joel Moran of the Pick a Side podcast where he criticizes the shortcomings of NBA player Kevin Durant when compared to other NBA legends like Michael Jordan, suggesting that Durant is not as strong of a player as some claim. item.description: The video was posted online in mid-July 2025, with people uncovering their identities and beginning to claim that they actually were having an affair with one another. In mid-December 2025, Cabot broke her silence on the story and stated that it was a "bad decision" after drinking and that the incident left her a "meme" unable to find employment.

item.title: Hard Choices For Members Of Specific Fandoms Illustrated In This Meme Format
item.description: Hard Choice For A Lot Of You is an exploitable meme format showing a man with a briefcase standing in front of a street sign between two forked paths reading, "Hard choice for alot of you X," with "X" referring to a specific fandom and something controversial that they enjoy. The meme is based on a stock image and first appeared on Reddit as early as September 2018, continuing to inspire memes over the following years.

item.title: You Ever Been Clowned By Your Gang For A Bummy Statement? This Poodle Meme Is For You
item.description: He Made a Statement So Trash Even His Gang Clowned Him refers to an exploitable recaption and reaction image meme, showing a small dog next to a vertical text caption.
